item.title: Defuse the AI Illusion - Cyber Security in the Age of AI
item.description: Join us on October 7th from 10 am to 12 pm in LOW 4050 for a Information Security presentation of Cyber Security in the Age of AI: Risks, Realities, and Responses. This presentation will also be an opportunity to see a real-world demonstration of an AI deepfake reporting a fraudulent incident in attempts to disrupt Business Operations.

item.title: RPI Faculty In-Person Workshop - Getting to Know the Basics of Generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) within the Classroom
item.description:
Date: Tuesday, October 13, 2026 1:00 PM - 2:00 PM - In this workshop we will look at some of the basics of AI, terminology, explore how prompts influence the responses these systems generate, and discuss tools available. As faculty and instructors, we don’t need to become AI experts. However, having a basic understanding of these tools can help us make thoughtful decisions about assignments and classroom expectations. Please click the link in the See section to register by Friday, October 9th…
